frontier.hypothesis: Class C can still be won if some C-level change makes the merged dest/sll quantity's qty_compare priority drop below the bare lw's 20000 while the flip is in place.
frontier.mechanism: qty_compare priority is floor_log2(refs)*refs*size/(death-birth)*10000. The merged chain is currently span 28 / refs 22 (pri 31428) and is ranked ord1, taking $v0 ahead of the lw. Dropping it below 20000 needs span > 44 or refs <= 15; then the lw is allocated first into $v0 over [48,52) and the chain is forced to $v1 - the target's seat. This is a DIFFERENT axis from the three input-perturbation families the solver enumerated (those perturb qty0/qty1/qty4; this perturbs qty3 itself, which the --swap goal held fixed).
